transport: BLE advertisement — no connection and no pairing session needed to READ, though pairing is needed once to obtain the per-device key. Victron manufacturer data, byte 3 must be 0x10 (Product Advertisement). The extra-manufacturer-data record begins at byte 8 and runs to the end. Header: bits 0-7 record type, bits 8-23 nonce/data counter LSB-first, bits 24-31 byte 0 of the encryption key. Payload is
blocks: Record type 0x01 = Solar Charger. Field layout, offsets from the start of the record: bit 32 width 8 device state (NA 0xFF, VE_REG_DEVICE_STATE) · bit 40 width 8 charger error (NA 0xFF, VE_REG_CHR_ERROR_CODE) · bit 48 width 16 battery voltage 0.01 V (NA 0x7FFF, VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL1_VOLTAGE) · bit 64 width 16 battery current 0.1 A signed (NA 0x7FFF, VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL1_CURRENT) · bit 80 width 16 yield today 0.01 kWh (NA 0xFFFF, VE_REG_CHR_TODAY_YIELD) · bit 96 width 16 PV power 1 W (NA 0xFFFF, VE_REG_DC_INPUT_POWER) · bit 112 width 9 load current 0.1 A range 0-51.0 A (NA 0x1FF, VE_REG_DC_OUTPUT_CURRENT) · bits 121-159 unused. Other record types defined but belonging to other catalogue files: 0x00 Test, 0x02 Battery Monitor, 0x03 Inverter, 0x04 DC/DC, 0x05 SmartLithium, 0x06 Inverter RS, 0x07 GX-Device (layout TBD), 0x08 AC Charger, 0x09 Smart Battery Protect, 0x0A Lynx Smart BMS, 0x0B Multi RS, 0x0C VE.Bus, 0x0D DC Energy Meter. 0x0E-0xFF unassigned as of the 2022 snapshot.

Grepping the full extracted text for dongle\|ASS030\|VE.Direct\|instant\|readout\|Phoenix\|SmartShunt\|product returns only VE_REG_BMV_* register names and one incidental "
gotchas: UNREADABLE WITHOUT THE PER-DEVICE 16-BYTE AES KEY, which comes out of VictronConnect's product-info page after pairing (or its SQLite advertisementKeys table). There is no vendor-supported way to derive it. A gateway that has never been paired sees ciphertext. This is a commissioning step PER DEVICE, at the bench, with

INSTANT READOUT IS OFF BY DEFAULT. VictronConnect's manual says so. A SmartSolar out of the box does not advertise a 0x01 record until somebody opts in. Built-in Bluetooth is necessary, not sufficient.

CHANGING THE BLUETOOTH PIN CHANGES THE KEY. Byte 0 of the key is echoed in every advertisement so a receiver can detect the mismatch; the vendor's instruction is then to DISCARD the stored key and stop decoding, not retry.

DO NOT BOUNDS-CHECK THE RECORD LENGTH. The vendor: 'an implementation should not perform an upper bound check on the length ... a length check should be performed for all items when retrieving data from the record.' Bit offsets are stable; presence is not. A fixed-size struct parse breaks on a firmware update.

FIELDS ARE BIT-PACKED ACROSS BYTE BOUNDARIES and every field has its own NA sentinel sized to its width. Byte-oriented parsing is wrong here, and treating a sentinel as a value produces plausible garbage.
unmappedReports: Charger error (bit 40, VE_REG_CHR_ERROR_CODE) — the numeric code. `ChargeStage::Fault` keeps the fact and drops the number., Device state (bit 32) values with no `ChargeStage` variant — Storage, Power supply, Starting-up, Repeated absorption, BatterySafe, External control., The off-reason carried in sibling record types — no MetricKind for why a device is off.
